text:
morgan: quick postmortem summary from last night — we saw a sustained alert storm from the model-serving queue overflow (route: /v1/generate, model: open-ggml-xl). postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/IN-4820. main asks: a) reduce noise (dedupe + rate-based), b) tighten paging policy, c) assign owners and deadlines. who can take what?
jlee: i can own dedupe + suppression window. plan: implement 60s dedupe per route+model, add a short-term global throttle for identical stack traces. will open PR against infra-alerts by Wed (IN-4821). rough snippet i'll use:```yaml
alert_key: "route_model_error"
dedupe: 60s
group_by: ["route","model"]
```
anya: i'll take threshold tuning and add a rate-based alert (errors per min) rather than raw counts. want to run the new thresholds in staging for 48h before rolling to prod. target for tuning + eval: this Friday EOD (IN-4822). i'll add a small eval set to Redwood Optimize to check for false positives.
sam: paging policy change request: only page on S3 when either (a) >3 distinct hosts report the error in a 5m window OR (b) error rate >1% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets. i'll update the oncall runbook with the new signal logic and escalation matrix. i'll take ownership of roll-out and ops playbook changes (PM-910).
pagerbot: Incident IN-4820 postmortem uploaded by morgan — summary + links — notification to #eng-oncall sent 2026-03-22T23:14:16Z
morgan: thanks all. to confirm owners/timelines: jlee -> dedupe (PR Wed, rollout Thu), anya -> thresholds (staging 48h, prod Fri EOD), sam -> paging/runbook (update Thu, notify oncall). i'll consolidate these into the postmortem and add a 4-week follow-up cadence: weekly check-ins every Tue 11am for 4 weeks to monitor reduction in alert volume and look for recurrence patterns. i'll also add a ticket for longer-term telemetry work to correlate alerts with prefix-cache churn (IN-4880).
jlee: noted. i'll include unit tests + a smoke job to validate dedupe logic before rollout. :thumbsup:
anya: will add eval dashboard and a rollback threshold in the alert meta. if false positives increase, we rollback and sync.
sam: will add pager escalation change to runbook and send a heads-up email to SRE and platform next week.
morgan: perfect. action items recorded in PM doc and in project board. thanks everyone — please update your ticket when PRs or runbook changes are live. we'll review metrics at the first follow-up (Tue 11am). :eyes:
